{{Top|leg}}
'''Comsets''' were communications equipment used by [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the field. They were often used by [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] to maintain contact with their forces. [[Bothawui Communications Conglomerate/Legends|Bothawui Communications Conglomerate]] manufactured the [[OmniNode communications set]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
